note: Photographs taken out of slots without deleting a file. An entry with `slots` is benched from those slots only — a moved photograph is benched from its old bucket and served in its new one (`movedTo`). scripts/image-slot-manifest.mjs serves each benched slot its `fallback`: the week-collapse slot (week_1 slot 1 of the same folder and time) unless a line on that photograph names a weekday, then the next slot in the same order with none (`fallbackSkipped`). An entry without `slots` is benched everywhere its bytes are. Only the built site is affected; an unbuilt local preview still reads the files. To un-bench, delete the entry.
